refund: payment with negative amount_minor and one invoice ref
payment_rule: a payment with one reference moves the invoice's receivable by round_half_even(booked * paid_after / total) - round_half_even(booked * paid_before / total), where booked is the invoice's posted base amount and paid counts earlier posted payments of it (refunds reopen it the same way); an overpayment closes what is left and puts the excess at the payment date's rate on unallocated; a payment of several invoices closes each in full; an advance goes to unallocated; cash is the payment at its date's rate and the rest of every foreign payment is its own fx_difference row
duplicate_signature: entity, currency, total, line items incl. service period
